remaining_open_items: The inductance-drop and temperature-rise percentages associated with the two current ratings are not given in this summary sheet.
The fitted saturation curve, thermal resistance and ceramic alternative remain uncertain.

Former simulation blocker resolved for the explicitly bound reference (2026-10-08): Do not use assumed 30% saturation drop / 40 K rise as sourced thermal or saturation limits. Resolution: The model side closes by following the OHM-044 pattern: a DC winding-resistance-only binding (R = maximum DCR) that uses neither a saturation drop nor a temperature rise, so the assumed 30 %/40 K values never enter. The source side does not close yet: the only archived copy is the Murata-generated 'Product Search Data Sheet' hosted at farnell.com (an image-only PDF; values read from the rendered page 2), which the brief treats as secondary, and DECISIONS round 4 already lists OHM-041 as distributor-backed. The sheet itself names the Murata URL to download from; that copy must be archived (murata.com was unreachable here) before the recipe counts.
